name: Amamiya Tamaki
source:
Tamaki is [url=/c986]Kurara[/url]'s stepmother and Masaki Amamiya's present wife. She used to be an able secretary to Masaki. She married Masaki after Yurika had died. She is not kind to Kurara.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hoshiuta#Supporting_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
